seats.name: single
argv:
Repair scheduling.ts. It exports two independent functions; both must be correct.

mergeIntervals(intervals): merges a list of closed intervals [start, end]. Two
intervals that only touch (one interval's end equals the other's start) count
as overlapping and must be merged into one. Input may be given in any order.

tierRate(quantity, tiers): tiers is sorted ascending by `min`. Return the rate
of the highest tier whose `min` the quantity has reached -- a tier applies
once quantity is at least (inclusive of) that tier's min. If quantity is below
every tier's min, return the first tier's rate.

Preserve both exported function signatures. Modify scheduling.ts in this
workspace; a chat answer alone is not a submitted code repair. Use no network
or dependencies. The evaluator runs private tests against your code after
completion.

Modify the relevant source file(s) in your current working directory directly to implement the fix described above. Your edit to the existing file(s) is the submission; do not create any other output file.
seats.text:
I fixed both functions in `scheduling.ts`, but I haven't run any tests.

- **`mergeIntervals`:** the merge check was `cur.start < last.end`, so intervals that only touch were left separate. It's now `<=`, so they merge.
- **`tierRate`:** the tier check was `quantity > t.min`, which left out a quantity exactly on a tier's minimum. It's now `>=`, so that tier applies.

Both exported signatures are unchanged.
